# Reagan Clift. I do what I'm told. Good - gets the job done. I think it's easy to use and relatively intuitive. #### What's great. I personally wish I had an easier time using. I prefer having folders rather than "labels".....even though they work similarly lol and I just prefer the way the "rules" are set up in Outlook. My personal favorite way to have a video meeting. No nonsense and easy to use. Doesn't have a ton of other fluff that adds to the confusion like other platforms.

# James Clift. I’d define my career to date as simply avoiding getting a job as long as possible. Some of it has worked. So far, the most impressive thing I've built is VisualCV. We make an online resume builder that grew to 4 million users, over $3m annual recurring revenue, and was named the 28th fastest growing startup in Canada in 2018. I also founded @holopod (sold to Pulse).
